summary: Verification/hardening phase. Proves the passive Runtime Registry prototype (110E) remains metadata-only, non-executing, compatible with 109A-109D and 110A-110D, fails safe under every malformed/duplicate/unknown input, and exposes enough read-only metadata for introspection. Metadata-only boundary re-verified by inspecting PluginDescriptor field types directly (none Callable/module-reference) and sweeping RuntimeRegistry's dir() for any load/instantiate/invoke-named method (none found). Contract compatibility verified against live doc/module text: all ten PLUGIN_CATEGORIES, eight LIFECYCLE_STATES, ten CAPABILITY_CLASSES, three IMPLEMENTATION_STATUSES cross-checked against docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_PLUGIN_CONTRACTS.md; the five 110D API operations this prototype implements confirmed present in docs/PCAE_RUNTIME_REGISTRY_CONTRACT.md; 109C's INTEGRATION_REGISTRY reconfirmed unchanged (exactly 4 entries, INT-001..INT-004); PermissionBroker().evaluate() (108A) reconfirmed unaffected, still reporting execution_unavailable. Resolution semantics re-tested and extended: registered/missing capability lookup, duplicate plugin ID and duplicate capability rejection, invalid/incompatible descriptor rejection, plus new coverage confirming every health state and lifecycle state (including unhealthy/disabled/failed/retired) is registerable as inert data and that find_capability() deliberately does not filter by health/lifecycle. Fail-safe behavior verified via a 7-descriptor malformed-field sweep and an 8-corruption single-field sweep (both confirm rejection-never-crash), confirmation that no provider returns () never a fallback, that multiple providers remain unfiltered candidates with no select_candidate/resolve_capability/choose_provider method anywhere on RuntimeRegistry, that an empty registry never implies execution, and that execute/enforce remain unregisterable under any plugin ID. Introspection readiness verified: registered plugin count, capability list, full plugin metadata, health/lifecycle status, and validation status all confirmed exposed via existing read methods; confirmed no CLI was added. One hardening fix within the verification/hardening boundary: PluginDescriptor.manifest is now a MappingProxyType snapshot taken at construction (__post_init__ + object.__setattr__), closing an aliasing gap where a caller-held manifest dict reference could mutate already-registered metadata even though the dataclass itself is frozen -- proven by dedicated tests including one that mutates the original dict after registration and confirms the stored descriptor is unaffected; deliberately shallow, not deep, copy. Added docs/PHASE_110_RUNTIME_REGISTRY_VERIFICATION.md. docs/ROADMAP.md evaluated and found to need no change. 68 new tests (tests/test_runtime_registry_verification.py); one-line update to tests/test_runtime_registry_prototype.py's isolation allowlist (types added). Focused tests (770), governance/autonomy group (1978), and the release/lifecycle regression subset actually present (1429/1429, excluding one nonexistent file and the two known-slow phase85/phase87 integration files) all passed under -n auto; fast_green 4390/4390 (matches documented baseline).

No daemon. No background workers. No automatic apply. No command execution.
